Team,

Quick ask to tighten our Q3 renewal forecast numbers for the GreenWave cohort. Finance wants a short, defensible set of probability adjustments before Friday so they can finalize the plan. I attached the GW_Q3_renewal_risk_matrix.xlsx — please do the following by EOD Thu 5/20:

- Normalize probabilities across the account list: apply the new Probability Guidance matrix (tab "guidance").
- Move deals to Commit only when: PO received, signed AM, or legal confirmation of start date.
- Flag churn-risk accounts (notes column) if customer has open support escalations, a delayed PO, or >30% usage decline QoQ.

Specifics for GreenWave (top line): current renewal date 7/15, proposed term 12 months, renewal estimate $465k. I want a short rationale line for any change in probability.

Please update the sheet live and reply with high-level changes in this thread. I will consolidate for finance.

Thanks — Marissa

--

- GovPilot integration (row 15): probability -> 75% (PO verbally committed, awaiting signed PO).

I've added brief evidence lines in the Notes column and linked the supporting email threads. I also attached a condensed "changes log" in the sheet (column H).

If finance needs explicit commit, we'll need PO by 5/25 for the GovPilot/Core rows — otherwise roll into pipeline at reduced probability.
